## Change

Describe the behavior changed and the public contract affected.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Python tests and Ruff pass
- [ ] Frontend tests and build pass when applicable
- [ ] Public audit and Gitleaks pass
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when applicable

## Public boundary

- [ ] No CV, cookies, tokens, credentials, SQLite data, or personal application data
- [ ] No auto-candidature, authenticated browsing, CAPTCHA bypass, or crawler for a `manual_only` source
- [ ] Source policy impact is explained when collection changes
